text:
maria: Quick sync — we need a clear grace period and reconciliation flow for HW credits tied to marketplace private offers when customers migrate from metered to commit. Customers expect credits to keep for X days after migration; partners expect seller credits to be reclaimed if not used. @aj can you propose an ops timeline? :thinking_face:
aj: 60-day grace seems industry-standard. propose: 30d soft hold -> 60d reconciliation -> 90d reclaim. keeps runway for pilots but limits drift. I can sketch ops steps.
ryan: Finance prefers reconciliation aligned to billing cycle. If commit starts on 2026-05-01, we'll want final reconciliation before next invoice period. 60d might push into next fiscal month, ok if legal signs off.
sam: Product concern: we can't change UX mid-announce. need to lock messaging. If we're doing a 60d reclaim window we should say "credits valid for 60 days post-migration" in docs and private-offer notes.
elena: Legal note — any reclaim clause needs notice language and a 30-day cure. suggest wording: "unused seller credits tied to private offers will be reconciled within 60 days; notice will be provided and credits may be reclaimed after a 30-day cure period." I'll draft.
maria: thanks. Can someone capture an ops runbook? minimal steps: 1) flag migrated accounts 2) compute used vs granted credits 3) notify partners/customers 4) execute reclaim if no response. include audit trail.
aj: I'll take runbook. rough snippet:
```
- Day 0: mark account migrated
- Day 0-30: apply soft hold, monitor usage
- Day 31: generate reconciliation report
- Day 45: send partner/customer notice
- Day 75: if no dispute, reclaim credits and notify
```
ryan: for invoicing, we need a CSV export from marketplace with columns: account_id, partner_id, grant_date, credit_amount, used_amount, remaining. I'll add that to billing tasks.
deploy-bot: doc created: https://internal.docs/redwood/marketplace/hw-credit-recon-draft (edited by aj)
maria: action items: aj runbook, ryan export schema, elena draft clause, sam lock UX copy. Let's meet Fri 10am PT to finalize. tagging @here for visibility :calendar:
elena: will add the 30-day cure language + a short FAQ for partners.
aj: pushed draft to the doc, ping when you want a walkthrough.
maria: perfect — thanks everyone. keeping this thread as single source for decisions.
